[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Email image-content gate: verify each image depicts its caption (Envoy review + gate build)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1815
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/go_to_market/pull/203
  
  Details:
  Reviewed and defended a freight newsletter's image set, then built a gate so the failure class cannot recur.
  
  Envoy (Discord 1548902290344255600) reviewed the delivered images against their captions by opening the actual pixels, and found two of four were wrong. I independently verified all six images with OCR plus grok-4.5 vision rather than accepting the report, and confirmed both -- plus found a third the review had not caught.
  
  Findings (all six opened):
  - freight-cargo-boat-header.jpg -- passenger luggage and 3 identifiable bystanders on a ferry deck, not cargo. Contradicted the email's air-cargo thesis.
  - ceremonial-cacao.jpg -- a Google-Maps-style map screenshot, not a photo. OCR reads "South Atlantic Ocean"; the vision pass read the pin label as "Fazenda Sao Jorge" (Bahia), a different farm from the claimed La do Sitio (Para).
  - black-king-packing-header.jpg (a later untracked "fix", 06:49) -- an outdoor beach selfie of two men. Depicts no packing, warehouse, or freight; added a second consent problem instead of removing one.
  - cacao-flower-to-bar.jpg -- two people handling paper strips in a packing room, not flower-to-bar production.
  - la-do-sitio-farm.jpg, bar-81-dark-chocolate.jpg -- verified accurate, kept.
  
  Resolution of a prior alarm: the image-directory edits were not a rogue process -- 4 files were tracked from commit 50ccd28 (PR #202) and 2 were the governor's untracked replacement attempt.
  
  Two PRs:
  1. agentic_ai_context #1815 -- new section 4.1 in EMAIL_STYLE_CONVENTION.md: image CONTENT correctness (depicts-what-it-claims, never dress a placeholder as evidence, filename/alt text are untrusted inputs), people-in-photos consent including bystanders, and a per-image verification row. Records the automation candidate as not-yet-built.
  2. go_to_market #203 -- scripts/verify_newsletter_images.py, a send-time gate (+267). Stdlib only, reuses the repo's proven grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning call. Per image returns scene type (photo vs map vs render), subjects-vs-claim, and identifiable-people count, then PASS/WARN/FAIL with non-zero exit on FAIL.
  
  Tested against all six real images, not fixtures:
  - Both negatives correctly FAIL (exit 1) -- ferry luggage, and the map pin whose label the model read aloud.
  - Both positives correctly clear -- PASS on the cacao pouch, honest WARN on the 81% bar because its label does not name the farm.
  - The later beach-selfie "fix" and flower-to-bar both FAIL.
  - --body-md on the current draft exits 2 "No image references found" -- deliberately refuses a vacuous pass.
  
  Deliberately not auto-wired into send_newsletter.py: a vision call per image adds latency and cost to every send, and whether the gate hard-blocks or warns is a governor decision.
  
  Time basis: task window 06:38-07:08 UTC on 2026-11-10 (draft mtime 06:38:38; PR #203 merged 07:08), three participants. No images changed, no draft edited, nothing sent.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh, Sophia Truesight, Envoy
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
